'''2008 New York State Championship Steve Jones DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Jones]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' how do you spell 'retard'?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
